name: Sparc Electrex Limited
about: Sparc Electrex Limited manufactures and trades in electric power tools, garden tools, cordless tools, and metals and metal products in India. It operates through Manufacturing of Electrical Tools & Service; and Trading segments. The company offers angle grinder, die grinder, die grinder kit, drills, rotatry hammer, impact drill, demolition hammer, blower, and saws. It sells its products under the ELECTREX and HYUNDAI brand names. The company was formerly known as Sparc Systems Limited and changed its name to Sparc Electrex Limited in January 2022. Sparc Electrex Limited was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
